text: PR #5407 update: first adversarial /code-review pass against 182888a4e found 4 more real issues, all fixed in 8490854e4: a FIFO-hang DoS from the final-component openat() being blocking (added O_NONBLOCK), a Windows root-open reparse-point check stricter than both the prior code and this PR's own POSIX side (would've broken package-alias-as-root on Windows; scoped to chain components only), a Windows post-walk safety-net check that was tautological because canonical_path was string-concatenated instead of read back from the verified handle (fixed with GetFinalPathNameByHandleW, mirroring the POSIX /proc/self/fd readback), and an ENOTDIR misclassification (diagnostic-only, disambiguated via fstatat). Deferred a 5th finding (duplicate RAII wrapper classes vs existing ScopedFd/ScopedFileDescriptor/ScopedHandle) as issue #5408, sub-issue of #34. Re-ran the full local Linux battery clean (7/7) in a fresh non-ASan build tree. Second adversarial review pass + a fresh full Windows Native Validation dispatch against 400484623 are both running now before merge; the earlier Windows dispatch (run 33328528574) was against the pre-fix commit and should not be trusted.
